items.title: 6.11.1 Entropy, diffusion aur tarteeb ke tareeqon ki tadaad (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.1, printed page 136.

blocks.text: Bukharat (vapour) ke molecules ittefaq (chance) se phailte (diffuse hote) hain. Yeh samajhne ke liye sochiye ke kisi ek waqt par un sab ke ek hi jagah milne ka imkan (probability) kitna hai. Figure 6.10 ka saada model dekhiye.

blocks.alt: Do ufuqi (horizontal) gas jars sire se sira jure hain aur beech mein partition hai. Baen gas jar A mein teen molecules hain jin par 1, 2 aur 3 likha hai; daen gas jar B khali hai. Labels: partition, gas jar A, gas jar B.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.10: Diffusion aur mumkin tarteebon ki tadaad (kitab ki Figure 6.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jar A mein teen molecules (1, 2, 3) hain aur jar B khali hai; beech mein partition (deewar) hai. Partition hatane par har molecule A ya B kisi mein bhi ja sakta hai.
Jar A se jar B mein diffusion ke baad yeh molecules do jars mein 8 mukhtalif tareeqon se tarteeb pa sakte hain.
Isi tarah agar shuru mein jar A mein 5 molecules hon to tarteebein 2⁵ = 32 hongi. Aur 100 molecules hon to 2¹⁰⁰. Aam formula xʸ hai, jahan x jagahon ki tadaad aur y particles ki tadaad hai.

Diffusion is liye hoti hai ke molecules ko tarteeb dene ke tareeqe bohat zyada hain. Particles ya un ki energy ki tarteeb ke ‘tareeqon ki tadaad’ se andaza hota hai ke koi process ho sakta hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Jar A mein gas ke 100 molecules hain jo khali jar B se jura hai. Stopcock kholne par kitni tarteebein mumkin hain, aur gas khud se wapas jar A mein kyun nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: 2¹⁰⁰ tarteebein, kyun ke har molecule do mein se kisi bhi jar mein ho sakta hai. In mein sirf ek tarteeb aisi hai jis mein saare 100 molecules A mein hon, is liye un ka khud wapas A mein jama hona taqreeban na-mumkin hai.

items: Tarteebon ki tadaad = xʸ (x jagahen, y particles): 3 molecules, 2 jars = 2³ = 8; 5 molecules = 32; 100 molecules = 2¹⁰⁰.
Diffusion is liye hoti hai ke phaili hui tarteebein bohat zyada hain.
